name: Condemned Hearts
source:
You are his judge. He is unrepentant. Somewhere between the verdict and the door, you will have to decide which one of you is lying about being able to walk away.

[From [url=https://puyoo.itch.io/condemned-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是他的法官。他死不悔改。在判决和关门之间的某个时刻，你们必须决定你们中的哪一个人在能够走开这一问题上撒了谎。

[来自[url=https://puyoo.itch.io/condemned-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
